title: Superlatives
summary: The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).
rule: The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).
examples: This is the best pizza in town.

commonMistakes.incorrect: This is the best pizza in town.
commonMistakes.correct: This is the best pizza in town.
commonMistakes.explanation: Review the grammar rule for this lesson.

tutorHints: At A2, encourage English-only explanations after the first example.
